# name: The Houses of Cold, Jaguars, Fire and Bats; the head of Hunahpu
# title: Xe oc chi cut pa Teuh Ha
# fols: fols. 26v–28v
Xe oc chi cut pa Teuh Ha. Maui ahilan teu; ꜩaꜩ chi zacbocom chupan ha, v ochoch teu. Huzu cu ꜩah teu rumal cuꜩ mamai na; xzach ri teu cumal ꜭaholab. Maui xe camic; xavi e ꜭazlic ta xzaquiric. Are ta cu xcah Xibalba chiri ta xe cam vi; maui quehe, xavi quꜩ qui vach ta xzaquiric. Xe quel chi vloc, tacol que xe be chic e chahal. “Naquipa la maui mi xe camic?” xꜭha chi rahaual Xibalba. Xqui maihah chic qui banoh ꜭaholab Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Cate xe oc chi cut pa Balami Ha; ꜩaꜩ chi balam, balam rochoch. “Maui coh i tio; ꜭo ivech chuxic,” xe vꜭhaxic balam. Cate cut xqui puquih bac chi qui vach chicop. Cate cut que pacaquic chi ri chuvi bac. “Mi ca xe vꜩinic; mi xu tih qui ꜭux; cate vi ri mi xqui ia quib. Are qui baquil ri ca xuxic,” xeꜭha ri varanel, conohel qui qui ꜭux chire. Maui xe camic; xavi xere vꜩ qui vach xe el vloc pa Balami Ha. “Naquipa qui chi e vinaquil? Apa qui xe pe vi?” xeꜭha ri Xibalba conohel.

Cate chic xe oc chupam ꜫaꜫ, hun ha chi ꜫaꜫ, xa vtuquel ꜫaꜫ v pam. Maui xe catic rumal, xa bolol, xa ꜩimah vi. Xavi xere vꜩ chi qui vach ta xzaquiric. Are ta cahauaxic huzuc ta que camic chupan ri, que icou vi; maui quehe, xavi ca zach qui ꜭux Xibalba rumal.

Xe coh chic chupan Zoꜩin Ha; vtuquel zoꜩ chupam chi ha, hun ha chi Camazoꜩ, nimac chicop, queheri Chaquiꜩam qui camizabal; huzu chuꜩinic chopor chi qui vach. Xe ꜭohe cu chiri chupam; xa pa vvb xe var vi. Maui xe tiyic rumal ri e ꜭo pa ha; chiri cut xqui ya vi quib hun vi rumal hun chi Camazoꜩ chi cah xpe vi; xavi vcutbal rib ta xqui bano rumal. ꜭo ca qui ꜩonoh vi qui naoh hun acab cu ri zoꜩ, que buhuhic: “Quiliꜩ, quiliꜩ,” que ꜭha, que ꜭha hun acab. Xtane cu ri zcaquin; mahabi chic que zilobic ri zoꜩ; chiri ca chacal vi ri hun ꜩam vvb. Xcha cu ri Xbalanque: “Hunahpu, cahanic pa v zaquiric? Ca vilo.” “Cahanican labalo; vila na,” xꜭha cut. Qui cu are ca rah mucum vloc chu chi vvb, ca rah ril vloc v zaquiric; catepuch ta xcupix v holom rumal Camazoꜩ, cupul chi canoc v nimal ri Hunahpu. Huchatic: “Ma mi xzaquiric?” xꜭha ri Xbalanque. Mahabi chic chi zilobic ri Hunahpu. “Hupacha ma xa on mi xbec Hunahpu? Hupacha mi xa bano?” Mahabi chic chi zilabic, xa qui chi co zoz chic. Catecut xu quixbih Xbalanque: “Acaroc! mi xca yayan,” xcha cut. Chila cut xbe colana vi v holom chuvi hom, xavi vꜩih Huncame, Vvcub Came. Que quicot cu ri Xibalba conohel rumal v holom Hunahpu.

Cate cut ta xu tac chicop ronohel, ziz, ac, ronohel chuti chicop, nima chicop, chacab; xavi xare racabal ta xuꜩonoh cut quecha: “Naqui tac pa ivecha chi huhunal? Are quix nu tac vi chi cam vloc ri ivecha,” xꜭha cut Xbalanque chique. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut. Ta xe bec e camol rech, ta xe ul he cut conohel. ꜭo xa cumar rech xbe v cama; ꜭo xa ꜩalic xbe v cama; ꜭo xa abah xbe v cama; ꜭo xa vleu xbe v cama. Halahoh quecha ri chicop, nima chicop. Qui pu ca v xambe canohoc ri tiz coc, xbe v cama cubulcutih; chuꜩam ca petic, are cut xoc halvachibal v holom Hunahpu; libah chi xcotix v bac v vach. ꜩaꜩ chi ahnaoh chi cah xpe vi; are v ꜭux cah, Huracan, xul coloc, xulu culoc chiri pa Zoꜩi Ha. Ma cu atan xuꜩinic v vach; vꜩ chic xuxic; xavi xare v chuuc hebel xvachinic; xavi xare xꜭhauic.

Are cut ta chi rah zaquiric, chi cactarin v xecah, ca xaquinuchic. “Ama xuchux ri vuch?” “Ve,” xꜭha ri mama. Ta chi xaquinic, cate ta chi queꜫumar chic; cahmul xaquin ri mama. “Ca xaquin v vuch,” ca ꜭha vinac vacamic. Xa cu cac raxaꜩinic ta xu tiquiba v ꜭohic. “Ma vꜩ cha chux cut Hunahpu he?” “Vꜩ,” xꜭha cut. Xavi xare chu baquitila v holom, quehe ri quiꜩih v holom xuxic.

Cate cut ta xqui ban qui ꜩih, xe pixaban quib, mana qui cut chaahic. “Xa qui chayecuh avib.” “Xa in hun qui qui banouic,” xꜭha Xbalanque chire. Cate cut ta xu pixabah hun vmul: “Cat ꜭoleta chiri chuvi hom, chi vi cat ꜭohe vi chupan pixc,” xuꜭhax vmul rumal Xbalanque. “Chopon na quic avuꜭ, cate cat elic; ca in qui banouic,” xuꜭhax ri vmul ta xpixabaxic chacab. Cate cut ta xzaquiric; xavi xare vꜩ qui vach qui cabichal.

Xcah chi cu qui chaah, colan chi cu v holom Hunahpu chuvi hom. “Mi xca chacoyan! Mi xi bano qui yan; mi xi yao,” xe vꜭhaxic. Xavi cu xere chi ziquin Hunahpu: “Chacuca ri holom chi quic,” que vꜭhaxic. Ma cu chi qui ca caxou chic; chi yecoub quib. Are cu xeꜩacou quic rahaual Xibalba; xu cul cut Xbalanque. Tacal cu ri quic chuvach bate; chi tanenic ta xelic; huzu cu xicou quic chuvi hom; xa hun xa canab vi tacal pa pix. Ta xel cu ri vmul chi coxcotic ta xbec; ocotal cut ta xbe cumal ri Xibalba, que huminic, que chaninic xe be chirih ri vmul; xe quiz be conohel Xibalba.

Catecut xqui camixtah ri v holom Hunahpu; xtiquixtah chic v coc Xbalanque. Are chi cut xbe qui cuba ri coc chuvi hom. Quiꜩih holom chi cu v holom ri Hunahpu; que quicot chi cu qui cabichal. Are cut que be ꜩucu na quic ri Xibalba. Catecut xqui camixtah chiri quic pa pix, ta xe ziquin chi cut: “Quix petoc! Vae quic que mi xca rico,” xeꜭha qui colem chi cut.

Ta xe ul Xibalba: “Naquipa ri mi xquilo?” xeꜭha cut, ta xqui tiquiba chi cut chaahic. Hunam chaahic chi cut xqui ban chic qui cabichal. Catecut xcacatah ri coc rumal Xbalanque, chi pucabin ri coc; xcah pa hom, zaquiram cu ri v zaquilal chi qui vach. “Naquipa ri chi be i cama? Apa ꜭo vi ri camol re?” xꜭha Xibalba. Quehe cut qui chacatahic rahal Xibalba rumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Nima caxcol xe cohe vi; maui are xe cam vi ri ronohel xban chique.
